visualCharacteristics.purpose: Employee quotation with a circular portrait and attribution
visualCharacteristics.layout: Centered column: portrait, quotation, attribution pinned to the bottom so side-by-side quotes align; two or more adjacent Quote blocks in one section sit side by side from 900px

contentPattern.structure: row 1: portrait image (optional); row 2: quotation; row 3: attribution (name, role)
contentPattern.example: Rashad Richard portrait, quotation, '— Rashad Richard, Vendor Management Specialist'

usage: 'Why work with us' section: two consecutive 'Quote' blocks in one section
reuseGuidance: One Quote block per person. Place quotes one after another in the same section to show them side by side (no section style needed; this project's aem.js does not apply Section Metadata styles). Italic text in the attribution is rendered as <cite>.
